Bundled source files:
- Vocabulary/暴恐词库.txt
- Vocabulary/反动词库.txt
- Vocabulary/色情词库.txt
- Vocabulary/色情类型.txt
- Vocabulary/涉枪涉爆.txt
- Vocabulary/贪腐词库.txt
- Vocabulary/补充词库.txt

The selected word-list files are bundled unchanged. CombatPets normalizes
entries in memory before matching pet names.
